title: EndpointContribution
description: A code-declared remote-callable endpoint: HTTP/HTTPS route, gRPC method, GraphQL resolver, message-handler endpoint, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` (Spring MVC/WebFlux today); future `JaxRsScanKS`, `MicronautScanKS`, `QuarkusScanKS`, `FastApiScanKS`, `ExpressScanKS`, `GrpcScanKS`, etc. all populate the same envelope.

handlerSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the handler method/function (back-pointer to Index.ScipSymbol). Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

containerSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the enclosing controller / resource / router class, when applicable.

framework.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Open enum tagging the producer techno.

httpMethods.description: HTTP methods bound by this endpoint. Required when protocol=http.

path.description: Route path / template (e.g. '/users/{id}', '/api/v1/orders'). Required when protocol=http or graphql.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Framework-specific facts that don't fit the universal core (e.g. Spring `@PreAuthorize` SpEL, JAX-RS `@RolesAllowed`, FastAPI `dependencies=[...]`, gRPC service descriptor index).
